title: Weak Content-Security-Policy (unsafe-eval)
description: The Content-Security-Policy header allows string-to-code evaluation through the 'unsafe-eval' source expression. Injected text can then call eval-style APIs even when inline scripts are blocked.
remediation: Remove unsafe-eval from script-src and move dynamic code to static functions (a policy without 'unsafe-eval').
limitation: Header value check on the token. Policies that also set a nonce for every script still list unsafe-eval, and this check flags them.
